component.name: Herdr
component.summary: Terminals and coding agents that keep running

description.p: This is a community package of Herdr, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified.
Herdr is a desktop window for terminals and coding agents. The terminals run in a separate herdr-core daemon, so closing the window leaves them running.
Install herdr-core on the host first: curl -fsSL https://releases.herdr.dev/core/install.sh | sh

Permissions: by default this package grants display, network, notifications, secret storage, audio, and a host command bridge. herdr-core and every command Herdr runs are forwarded through Flatpak's host-spawn portal and run on the host, so this package is not a sandbox. Agents on the host that call herdr-app need a host shim such as ~/.local/bin/herdr-app containing exec flatpak run dev.herdr.app "$@".
Usage telemetry is on by default, as upstream ships it. Turn it off in Settings, Privacy.
The file panel and git info read the folders your terminals are in, which needs access to your files. It is not granted by default; enable it with "flatpak override":
